entries.64f8fbcfc2bbcde1: The company's basic management policy is to focus on 'Clean, Health, Safety' as its business domains and to supply products based on highly original technologies. Its starting point for research and development is 'what the world does not have' and 'what is truly useful', and rather than scale, it aims to become a technology-founded company that holds 'only-one' and 'number-one' technologies and products that only it can offer in the world. As initiatives by field, it plans to promote the 'KOACH' open clean system, which achieves ISO Class 1 cleanliness, in the clean field; expand the market share of the infection-control N95 mask 'Hairakku 350 type' in the health field; and develop products such as the 'Buresurinku' series of powered respirators in the safety field.
entries.6682db0f265d91eb: This business manufactures and sells environment-related equipment, such as the open clean system 'KOACH'. KOACH is a clean device that achieves ISO Class 1, the highest standard level of cleanliness, and its sales are growing mainly in the domestic semiconductor market.
